movie.title: Another Day
movie.overview: Garance is a young actress, but not a star. She manages everything as best she can, valiant, cheerful, a soldier, and she finds in alcohol an unconditional fuel, a source of comfort. Garance changes her life and begins an eight-year journey of moves, work, encounters, parties and anxieties, joys and hardships… An intimate, friendly, and sexual revolution. But she consumes, more and more. Until the very possibility of death…

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Struggling actress Garance navigates eight turbulent years of personal, sexual, and professional transformation while fighting an increasingly dangerous battle with alcohol addiction.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Garance is a resilient yet unestablished young actress who relies heavily on alcohol as a coping mechanism for life's challenges. Over an eight-year journey marked by constant moves, career hurdles, new relationships, and vibrant social life, she undergoes a profound personal evolution. However, her escalating substance abuse steadily shadows her progress, threatening her health and stability. Ultimately, Garance must confront the reality of her addiction before her self-destructive path leads to tragedy.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Garance moves through the world with a brave face, balancing her aspirations as an actress with the mundane struggles of everyday life. Unable to achieve stardom, she relies on her optimistic demeanor and a steady stream of alcohol to fuel her ambition and soften her anxieties. Over the course of eight chaotic years, Garance embarks on a journey of constant change, moving from place to place while pursuing acting jobs and forging intense new friendships. Her life becomes a backdrop for an intimate sexual and social revolution, filled with high-energy parties, creative encounters, and deep personal joys. Yet beneath the vibrant surface, her heavy drinking gradually shifts from a comforting social lubricant into an overwhelming physical dependency. As her anxiety worsens, the hardships of her unstable lifestyle begin to outweigh the excitement of her independence. Friends and colleagues notice her decline, but Garance continues to push her body and mind to their absolute limits. The escalating consumption reaches a critical boiling point where her habits directly endanger her survival. Pushed to the very edge of mortality, Garance is forced to face the profound emotional wounds driving her addiction and decide if she can reclaim control of her future.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Garance is a spirited, working-class actress striving to build a life in an unpredictable industry. Outwardly cheerful and resilient, she relies on alcohol as a primary source of comfort and energy to navigate the stresses of her career. The narrative follows her over an eight-year period filled with intense personal growth, artistic pursuits, shifting relationships, and a vibrant social life. As she experiences an intimate revolution in her identity and independence, her reliance on alcohol steadily deepens into a dangerous dependency that threatens to undermine everything she has built.

story_structure.climax: Her reckless consumption reaches a critical, life-threatening peak where the immediate reality of death forces an inescapable reckoning with her lifestyle.
story_structure.conflict: As Garance embarks on a transformative eight-year journey filled with new jobs, relocations, and relationships, her growing dependence on alcohol creates a deep tension between her vibrant personal revolution and her self-destructive habits.
story_structure.resolution: Garance confronts the impact of her long journey, laying the groundwork for a sobering transformation and a shift toward true healing and stability.
story_structure.introduction: Garance, a valiant and cheerful young actress struggling to navigate her career and personal life, relies on alcohol as a primary source of comfort and energy.
story_structure.risingAction: Over the years, Garance experiences a whirlwind of professional and personal highs and lows, but her substance consumption escalates steadily alongside her anxieties, pushing her closer to a breaking point.
